description: Send coding tasks from any chat to Claude Code or Codex in boat.dev cloud sandboxes, then review the pull requests they open. A Cloud agents page shows every task with its transcript, report, pull request and private preview link. The other model can review each change before it lands as a draft pull request, or ships to the base branch after you approve it. An optional orchestrator chat plans a project's work, starts the tasks and brings you only decisions and finished results. Requires a boat.dev account and plan, the boat CLI (macOS or Linux) on the bb machine, GitHub connected on boat.dev, and a Claude or ChatGPT subscription connected in boat.dev; task chats, chats on a Boat sandbox and cloud orchestrators also need bb Connect.
